prompt: Who was the Argentinian president who resigned from the position the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated?
answer: Pedro Pablo Ramírez. He resigned as Argentina’s de facto president in June 1944, the same year the José Martín Olaeta Stadium was inaugurated (April 15, 1944).
